lead_has_client_ck.name: lead_has_client_ck
lead_has_client_ck.value: "lead"."wedding_id" IS NOT NULL OR "lead"."client_name" IS NOT NULL

message_not_empty_ck.name: message_not_empty_ck
message_not_empty_ck.value: "message"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "message"."attachment_url" IS NOT NULL

review_ratings_ck.name: review_ratings_ck
review_ratings_ck.value:
"review"."rating" between 1 and 5
        and ("review"."rating_professionalism" is null or "review"."rating_professionalism" between 1 and 5)
        and ("review"."rating_service" is null or "review"."rating_service" between 1 and 5)
        and ("review"."rating_availability" is null or "review"."rating_availability" between 1 and 5)
        and ("review"."rating_value" is null or "review"."rating_value" between 1 and 5)

vendor_price_range_ck.name: vendor_price_range_ck
vendor_price_range_ck.value: "vendor"."price_from_agorot" IS NULL OR "vendor"."price_to_agorot" IS NULL OR "vendor"."price_from_agorot" <= "vendor"."price_to_agorot"
